crossRefs.note: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your…
I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
For bronze I will bring gold; for iron I will bring silver; for wood, bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make…
The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

translations.web: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.
translations.bsb: And he overlaid the temple floor with gold in both the inner and outer sanctuaries.
translations.kjv: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
translations.asv: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
